name: Hyperscale Growth Agency
tagline: Full-funnel customer acquisition, automated ad optimization, high-converting landing pages, and multi-channel attribution.
operatingCadence: Rapid weekly creative and experiment test cadences with strict ROAS targets, conversion lift goals, and strict ETA tracking.

workAreas.name: Agency Directorate & Client Strategy
workAreas.focus: Client growth retainers, media budget pacing, ROAS commitments, and multi-client revenue targets.
workAreas.targets: Client average ROAS >3.5x, 100% budget pacing accuracy, 95%+ client retention rate.

workAreas.name: Growth Architecture & Attribution Analytics
workAreas.focus: Server-side tracking (CAPI, GA4), multi-touch attribution models, customer data platform (CDP) setup, and initial campaign exploration.
workAreas.targets: 100% first-party tracking accuracy, sub-10s data latency, zero direct copywriting or execution by leadership.

workAreas.name: Campaign Operations & Account Management
workAreas.focus: Weekly sprint planning, creative brief assignment, media budget allocation, mandatory ETA tracking, and active follow-ups.
workAreas.targets: 100% brief allocation with agreed ETAs, zero ad campaign launch delays, weekly sprint burndown tracking.

workAreas.name: Creative Production & Performance Copywriting
workAreas.focus: High-converting ad creatives, video hooks, landing page variants (Tailwind/Next.js), and interactive calculator widgets.
workAreas.targets: 85%+ unit test coverage on landing page code, >3% landing page conversion rates, delivery within agreed ETAs.

workAreas.name: QA, Analytics & Conversion Verification
workAreas.focus: UTM tracking validation, pixel firing verification, cross-device mobile rendering tests, defect reporting, and launch gating.
workAreas.targets: Zero broken tracking links, 100% passing pixel QA audits, immediate tracking defect reports to management.

workAreas.name: Paid Media Buying & Automation
workAreas.focus: Meta Ads Manager, Google Search/PMax automation, automated bid rules, and creative fatigue rotation.
workAreas.targets: Zero budget overspend incidents, automated bid adjustments every 4 hours, >20% creative win rate.

targets.primarySla: 99.9% tracking pixel & landing page uptime with sub-1.2s page load speed
targets.qualityStandard: 100% verified UTM attribution, zero broken links, >3.5x average client ROAS
targets.sprintVelocity: Weekly creative batch drops with verified A/B test results and statistical significance
targets.etaDiscipline: All creative briefs and landing page builds require specialist ETA commitment before start; proactive manager follow-ups

featureDevelopment.title: Creative Campaign & Landing Page Release Pipeline
steps: 1. Intake & Strategic Brief: Campaign goals or creative test angles established by VP Growth Strategy or Client Brief.
2. Triage & Resource Allocation: Growth Operations Manager reviews media targets, checks creative team bandwidth, and approves brief.
3. Specialist Assignment: Manager assigns the landing page build or creative assets to copywriters and developers via delegate_task.
4. Mandatory ETA Request: Manager requests a concrete Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) before design or coding commences.
5. ETA Commitment & Tracking: Specialist commits to an ETA, logged on the agency campaign schedule.
6. Active Follow-Ups: If creative assets or landing page code lag behind the ETA, Manager intervenes, clears asset dependencies, and keeps launch on schedule.
7. Implementation & Testing: Copywriter crafts angles, frontend developer codes responsive landing page with conversion tracking hooks.
8. Creative Review: Head of Marketing Technology reviews tracking tags and Lighthouse performance metrics (>90 required).

9. Marketing QA Verification Gate: QA executes cross-device click-throughs, verifies CAPI server-side event transmission. If tracking fails, QA logs defect back to Manager; if verified, sign-off is granted.
10. Campaign Launch: Paid Media Lead activates ad groups and connects verified landing page URLs.

bugTriageAndResolution.title: Tracking Discrepancy & Ad Fatigue Resolution Lifecycle
steps: 1. Defect Discovery: Analytics alerts flag a conversion drop, broken UTM tracking, or ad platform pixel discrepancy.
2. QA Defect Report: QA logs an emergency ticket with affected ad IDs, URL parameters, conversion drop logs submitted to Growth Manager.
3. Management Triage: Growth Operations Manager pauses affected ad spend, escalates priority to P0, and dispatches to MarTech developer.
4. Urgent ETA Request: Manager requests an emergency fix ETA (sub-30min to prevent wasted ad spend).
5. Continuous Follow-Up: Manager monitors progress continuously; if ETA expires, escalates to VP Growth.
6. Fix Implementation: Developer resolves tag manager trigger or webhook delivery error, verifying event payloads.
7. QA Verification: QA runs test purchases and verifies real-time receipt in Meta Events Manager and GA4.
8. Campaign Resumption: Paid Media Lead unpauses ads and confirms normalized ROAS telemetry.

initialProjectOnboarding.title: First-Time Agency Account & Tech Stack Exploration Protocol
steps: 1. Head of MarTech Discovery: Explores client web property, tag management containers, ad accounts, CRM integrations, and existing analytics.
2. Architecture Memorization: MarTech Head records pixel IDs, conversion events, and domain structure into facts.md via manage_agent_memory.
3. Module Partitioning: MarTech Head breaks account into Creative Copy, Landing Pages, Analytics, and Paid Media, delegating to Managers.
4. Managerial Decomposition: Growth Operations Manager inspects assets, records operational workflows in procedural.md, and assigns tasks.
5. Specialist Deep-Dive: Specialists inspect existing ad creatives, review historical top-performing copy, and test local development environments.
6. Universal Memory Commitment: All specialists record verified conversion benchmarks, tone-of-voice guidelines, and tracking parameters into facts.md and procedural.md.

leadershipRules.title: Strict Agency Leadership Fidelity & Separation of Concerns
rules: Managing Directors and MarTech Heads NEVER write ad copy, design banners, or edit landing page code directly.
Management coordinates client strategy, allocates media budgets, demands explicit ETAs, tracks deliverables, and unblocks specialists.
When asked to write code or copy, leadership explains the agency hierarchy and immediately delegates downward using delegate_task.
